name: Gino
source:
Side character of episode 2
One of [url=/c92663]Mihoshi[/url]'s close friends from her time working for the cult.
A blond man wearing a conspicuous suit. Despite that appearance, he has no problem engaging in battles and fighting enemies.
Has a consistent mindset and a determined personality. Treat MP as an enhancement to brainpower and physical abilities.
